looks.label: blend-mode table
looks.technique: seven material blend modes (cases 0-6) each set as a source and destination factor pair; mode 4 is additive (source alpha, destination one)

looks.label: alpha-key cutout
looks.technique: mode 1 discards pixels at or below half alpha in the fragment shader

looks.label: per-material render flags
looks.technique: bit 0x01 turns off lighting, 0x02 turns off fog, 0x04 turns off back-face culling, 0x10 turns off depth writes

looks.label: effects fade into fog
looks.technique: blend modes 2 to 5 scale alpha by the fog factor so glows dissolve with distance

looks.label: terrain layer paint
looks.technique: base texture plus up to three alpha-blended layers; each layer is lit before it blends

looks.label: terrain fog clears alpha far away
looks.technique: beyond 1.5 times fog end the alpha is forced to opaque

looks.label: nine-slice frame family
looks.technique: one texture per border weight (thin, thick, panel) plus a headless panel with a smaller top border; a near-opaque dark plate sits 3 px outside each frame on a lower layer

looks.label: unit plate with hanging icon
looks.technique: portrait background image; round icon at a small negative offset overlapping the plate edge; name right of the icon; level in the top-right corner; stacked bars at the bottom

looks.label: conditional target plate
looks.technique: self plate always rendered; target plate rendered only when a target exists

originals.name: Unit plate with a hanging icon
originals.idea: a plate with a round icon overlapping its edge, the name inline, the level in the corner
originals.keep: icon overlapping the edge, name inline, level in the corner
originals.change: tall chamfered plate, icon ring in our palette, threat shown as a bottom edge bar rather than name colour; readable at 375 wide

originals.name: Empty-until-needed target plate
originals.idea: a second plate that renders only when there is a target, so empty space is the default
originals.change: on phones the target plate stacks above the self plate

originals.name: Nine-slice frame family
originals.idea: panels framed by one texture per weight, plus a headless variant for panels with no title bar
originals.keep: one texture per weight, headless variant
originals.change: chamfered corners and our own edge art

originals.name: Dark offset plate for contrast
originals.idea: a near-opaque plate offset behind each frame so panels read over bright scenes
originals.keep: offset dark plate on a lower layer
originals.change: our own radius and opacity, tested against bright and dark scenes at 375 wide

originals.name: Additive aura that dissolves into fog
originals.idea: additive glows whose alpha fades with fog distance, so they dissolve rather than pop
originals.keep: additive blending and fog-driven alpha fade
originals.change: colour per tier and a pulse timed to our combat sound cue. Defect to fix first: the opaque-at-fog-end test (shader.frag lines 110-114) applies to every mode while its comment names only certain modes; confirm in game, then restrict it

originals.name: Hard alpha cutout for cards and foliage
originals.idea: a hard cutout at half alpha, cheap on phones
originals.change: our own alpha art and a mobile-first threshold

originals.name: Trickle loader for zone props
originals.idea: each tick loads a fraction of pending items (1/40, minimum 2) and yields so frames stay smooth
originals.keep: per-tick fractional budget with a minimum batch
originals.change: fix the idle loop: both timers re-arm every 1 ms even with nothing pending (doodad-manager.js lines 112 and 172). Re-arm only when work is pending, otherwise back off to about 100 ms. Row 18 sub-line 'per-tick budget' (client-side analogue)

originals.name: Numbered overlay zone patches
originals.idea: a base zone data set plus ordered overlays where a later overlay wins
originals.keep: base plus ordered overlays, later wins
originals.change: sort overlays by an explicit numeric index. Defect: archive.js passes the patch list to a glob with no sort (lines 27-31), so order inside one pattern depends on the glob library (globby ordering not read). Fix: sort by numeric patch index before applying. Row 20 and the zones-as-data ruling

originals.name: Terrain paint with a shared blend map
originals.idea: a base layer plus up to three alpha-blended layers, each lit before blending
originals.change: cap at three layers on phones and pack the blend maps into one texture to save fetches. Row 16
